text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, music, and even writing. Some AI programs paint pictures or compose songs that sound completely new. Others help writers by suggesting ideas or finishing sentences. But is this real creativity? Humans create from emotions, experiences, and imagination. AI, however, learns from data and patterns. It does not feel joy or sadness when it makes something. So, while AI can produce impressive results, human creativity remains special. Perhaps the best future is when people and machines work together, combining human feelings with machine speed and skill.
